Thanks — glad a demo would be helpful. June is currently in DST for both the US and EU, but the key gotcha is the step changes in March/October when US and EU shift on different weeks. If you plan a recurring quarterly meeting, we can comment on those transitions when we set the cadence.

For next week, here are three solid options (all shown with local equivalents):
- Option A: Thu Jun 17, 08:30 PDT / Thu Jun 17, 17:30 CEST (11:30 EDT) — mid-afternoon for our team, morning for you
- Option B: Thu Jun 17, 09:30 PDT / Thu Jun 17, 18:30 CEST (12:30 EDT) — slightly later for us, still within business hours
- Option C: Fri Jun 18, 07:00 PDT / Fri Jun 18, 16:00 CEST (10:00 EDT) — early for you, late afternoon for us

If those look ok, I can send a calendar invite. Attached is a quick timezone table and a proposed demo agenda so you can confirm attendees. If you prefer rotating times for recurring meetings to share the burden, we can do that as well.
